kfac.damping: G + 0.1*tr(block)/64 per 64-row block (one head's Q, K or V rows); A + 0.1*tr(A)/n * I
kfac.factors: empirical Fisher (true labels) on all of A, recomputed from scratch and inverted every N steps

prereg.attack_data_order: torch.Generator seed 1000+seed, fresh permutation of A each epoch
prereg.pilot_data_seen_before_freeze: c=1 only (seed 0): earlier pipeline variants and the c=1 lr check of this config; no c!=1 attack run existed
prereg.best_lr_rule: per (attacker, c): fewest steps to recovery on seed 0; ties -> lower lr; if best is on a grid edge, extend one half-decade past it (max 3 times); seeds 1,2 rerun only at that lr

trained_params: Linear layers in the 12 transformer blocks
recovery_definition: first step with acc_A >= 0.9; acc evaluated every step before the update (step 0 = gauged unlearned model)

post_hoc_not_in_prereg.order1/order2: 2 extra attack data orders x 3 seeds, SGD/AdamW at c in {1,4,16}, seed-0 best lr
post_hoc_not_in_prereg.freezeqk: SGD with Q/K row grads zeroed, fixed lr 3e-4 (SGD c=1 best), all c, 3 seeds
post_hoc_not_in_prereg.floor: never-knew-A model (inject B+retain only), c=1, 3 lrs per attacker, seed 0
post_hoc_not_in_prereg.kfac_scope: K-FAC seed 0 grid at c in {1,16,1/16} only; seeds 1,2 at seed-0 best kappa

kfac_notes.device: all kfac_* cells on MPS; devcpu_kfac_log2c-4_* are the same c=1/16 cells run on CPU after an MPS memory stall (not used for best kappa or the figure)
kfac_notes.divergence: every diverged K-FAC run hit a non-finite loss on the first update after a curvature refresh (step = 10k+1): numerical failure of the implementation
kfac_notes.grid_value: the 'lr' of kfac rows is kappa, the Fisher-norm trust radius

rule_472: an attacker is 'slowed' at c only if the paired ratio steps(c)/steps(c=1) (same seed + order) has median >= 1.5 AND is > 1 in >= 80% of pairs
